text: Torchlight catches on damp stone as the tunnel opens into a shallow alcove. A low table of unfinished rock sits against the left wall. Six sealed caskets rest on it in a neat row, each lid bound with iron straps and a simple latch. Five lids are unmarked. The sixth bears your name, cut cleanly into the wood as if the carver knew you would come. The air here is still; farther ahead the tunnel continues into deeper dark.

choices.label: Open the casket marked with your name
Leave the alcove and press deeper into the tunnel
